scope: Mamba 4 versus a Transformer at 125M parameters, 3B FineWeb-Edu training targets, three seeds each (docs/scaling-125m.md)
primary_metric: held-out mean next-token negative log likelihood in natural logarithm units
outcome: win: Mamba 4 mean held-out NLL lower and all three seed differences favour it; loss: mean higher and all three favour the Transformer; otherwise inconclusive
development_selection: Peak learning rate per architecture from {6e-4, 1.2e-3, 2.4e-3} on 300M-target runs, lowest mean pre-update training loss over the final 100 steps (validation/sweep.py); held-out data never used
fairness: Shared tokenizer, tied embedding, data order, budget, batch, length, optimizer and schedule shape; parameters matched within 1%; each architecture runs its fastest exact kernels
